song2021.title: Cross Sections for Electron Collisions with H2O
song2021.role: recommended numerical compilation; primary lineage retained per channel

munoz2007.title: Electron-scattering cross sections and stopping powers in H2O
munoz2007.role: primary gas-phase experiment and optical-potential calculations

nist_beb.role: author-maintained orbital constants and nonrelativistic BEB formula; valence only; not branching

ram2010.title: Dissociative Electron Attachment to Polyatomic Molecules - I: Water
ram2010.role: primary gas-phase VMI; Eq4/angular fit and TableIII OH vibrational fit at6.5eV

nist_OH.role: NIST/Huber-Herzberg OH(X) constants and note22; Maillard,Chauville,Mantz JMolSpectrosc63,120(1976)
nist_OH.direct_archive: HTTP403; numerical binding verified on official web tool page, source snapshot retained externally

melton1972.role: Primary low-pressure OHminus attachment identification; TableIII and pp4221/4224. Rate here is the already frozen Song/Rawat-renormalized curve, not the original Melton magnitude.

hargreaves2012.role: Primary electron-impact A1B1 dissociative excitation, pp1-3: impulsive OH+H products, broad energy-loss profile and forward-peaked singlet DCS. The fixed-loss/dipole/ground endpoint below is conditional, not a transcription of the measured DCS.

murakami2012.role: Primary theoretical application of high-energy single-vacancy branching, Eqs27-30; empirical lineage Tan etal ChemPhys29,299(1978), DOI10.1016/0301-0104(78)85080-0. Proton collision dynamics are NOT imported as electron-impact rates.

nist_fragment_IE.role: OH evaluatedIE13.017eV and H evaluatedIE13.59844eV; official pages inspected; factual numerical snapshot retained externally

nist_srd64_v5.role: Official SRD64 v5 relativistic free-atom DCS exports for H(Z1),O(Z8), 1..10keV in1keV steps; downloaded via public interactive interface; not molecular measured DCS
nist_srd64_v5.exported_coordinates: d sigma/d omega vs theta; a0**2/sr; 0..180 degrees in1degree steps

montenegro2015.title: Inner valence-shell vacancy production and molecular fragmentation
montenegro2015.authors: E.C. Montenegro, A.C. Tavares, H. Luna, W. Wolff
montenegro2015.role: Primary Fig3 left panel, printed4/PDF5: absolute fractions of2a1 vacancy production, prompt Hplus58percent/Oplus15percent, Auger OHplus+Hplus14percent/Oplus+Hplus13percent. Sections2.1/3.1 discuss fast-collision universality and post-hole Auger electron. No proton-impact rates imported.
montenegro2015.limitations: High-velocity fragmentation matrix inferred using proton data/model; fixed application to1..10keV electron BEB holes is conditional, not measured electron differential validation.

nist_O_IE.role: Official oxygen first ionization energy13.618055eV; O3P to Oplus4S ground states
